title: Inventory signed device configuration
description: Authoritative per-device Inventory settings. The filename and license.sn are the uppercase Android ID. There is no default or wildcard document; unprovisioned devices fail closed. extra/session keys are rejected.

revision.description: Positive monotonic integer covered by the detached signature. remote-config 1.2.0 MonotonicLongRevisionPolicy rejects a lower revision and same-revision content changes.

license.description: license-library 1.0.2 entitlement. Omit expire for License.Permanent; set expire for License.Temporary. The expiry date is inclusive.

sn.description: Uppercase Settings.Secure.ANDROID_ID. Must equal the runtime filename stem and the remote-config refresh key. Inventory DeviceInfoUtil.getSN() already uppercases the identifier.

expire.description: Quoted four-digit YYYY-MM-DD calendar date. This is the InventoryConfig decoder convention: the value is passed to kotlinx.datetime.LocalDate.parse for license-library 1.0.2's License.Temporary.expire (a LocalDate). Default LocalDate.parse in kotlinx-datetime 0.6.1 uses extended ISO-8601 and may accept other lexical forms; those are outside this repository's contract. Quote the value so YAML 1.1 loaders do not coerce it to a timestamp. The date is inclusive: expire < trustedDate is expired.

server.description: Inventory HTTP API. Maps to AppConst.ServerAddr. There is no repository fallback URL.

url.description: Retrofit base URL stored as SharedPreferences key ServerAddr. Inventory’s live UI sample is R.string.server_addr_Sample (http://192.168.2.12:5000/); AppConst.DefaultServerAddr is unused. Neither string is a runtime fallback in this repository. Prefer a trailing slash.

reader.description: Authoritative RFID reader and tag-mode settings. Every modeled field is required. A valid signed document must not inherit mutable SharedPreferences or Inventory local defaults. Bluetooth pairing (DevPath, ConnectionString) is local session state and must not appear here.

deviceType.description: AppConst.DevType. Current Inventory default AppConst.DefaultDevType is RPAN; ConnectionStringFormat also hardcodes RDType=RPAN.

commType.description: AppConst.CommType. Current Inventory default AppConst.DefaultCommType is Bluetooth; ConnectionStringFormat hardcodes CommType=BLUETOOTH.

rfidType.description: AppConst.CurrentRfidType. ReadTagDataUseCase.RFIDType: HF=0, UHF=1. Current Inventory default is HF.

dataFormat.description: AppConst.CurrentDataFormat. arrays.xml dataFormat spinner: ISO=0, CUSTOM=1. Current Inventory default selection is 0 (ISO).

checkSecurity.description: AppConst.CurrentCheckSecurity. SettingActivity checkbox default is unchecked (false).

securityType.description: AppConst.CurrentSecurityType. arrays.xml securityType spinner: AFI + EAS=0, EAS=1, AFI=2.

afiInLib.description: AppConst.CurrentAfiInLib. Two hex digits written by RPan.doWriteAIF. Setting UI hint is 07.

afiOutLib.description: AppConst.CurrentAfiOutLib. Two hex digits. Setting UI hint is C2.

display.description: Authoritative Inventory display and shelf-management behavior. Every modeled field is required. A valid signed document must not inherit mutable SharedPreferences or Inventory local defaults. Current inventory task identity is session state and must not appear here.

showShelfDescription.description: AppConst.ShowShelfDescription. InventoryAdapter / SettingActivity default is false.

sort.description: AppConst.CurrentSort. arrays.xml sortType spinner: 架位绑定 + 中图法排序=0, 架位绑定=1, 中图法排序=2.
